// diagnostic

E3411

`#Impure` gate present but `--gate impure=allow` was not passed.

What

`#Impure` gate present but `--gate impure=allow` was not passed.

Why

The `#Impure` block opts in to ambient I/O, but the invocation gate is also required so CI can audit builds that touch the host.

Fix

add `--gate impure=allow` to your `jet build` / `jet run` invocation.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3411: tests/ui/impure_no_flag.stderr.

Error [E3411]: `core.files.read()` inside `#Impure` gate, but `--gate impure=allow` was not passed
  --> tests/ui/impure_no_flag.jet:5:20
    |
  5 |         @cfg :: fs.read("config.txt")
    |                    ^^^^
 Why: the `#Impure` block opts in to ambient comptime I/O, but the build flag is required so CI can audit builds that touch the host
 Fix: add `--gate impure=allow` to your `jet build` / `jet run` invocation
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3411

Error [E0107]: nothing named `@cfg` exists here
  --> tests/ui/impure_no_flag.jet:6:17
    |
  6 |         print("{@cfg}")
    |                 ^^^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `@cfg :: ...`
